from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Decode a magnified lattice into its cell colors."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The two common colors form the plain grid template; rare colors mark
    # lattice intersections. Ignore unmarked outer/template grid lines.
    template = {value for value, _ in counts.most_common(2)}
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if any(value not in template for value in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if any(grid[r][c] not in template for r in range(h))]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        out_row = []
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            corners = (grid[rows[i]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i]][cols[j + 1]],
                       grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j]], grid[rows[i + 1]][cols[j + 1]])
            out_row.append(corners[0] if all(value == corners[0] for value in corners) else background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
